  • LED prompts to guide safe operation
  • Audible alerts for issues like reverse connection or poor contact
  • Makes jump-starting easy and safe-even for first-time users

Rugged, Durable, and Lightweight Design

Built with a waterproof, dustproof, and shock-resistant shell, the Beta08 is designed for:

  • Extreme weather like rain, snow, and rough terrain
  • Travel and emergency kits
  • Reliable performance in tough environments

Wide Compatibility & Versatility

Use it with a wide range of vehicles and equipment:

  • Cars, motorcycles, SUVs, pickup trucks, RVs, boats, snowmobiles, lawnmowers, and more
  • Great for road trips, camping, or emergency roadside assistance

Low Maintenance, Long Standby

Three steps:

Step 1. Plug in. Insert the smart clamps to the jump starter - wait for the indicator to flash green.

Step 2. Clench it. Raise the hood of the car. Connect the clamps to car battery (red to +, black to -). The indicator will turn solid green if connected correctly.

Step 3. Start the car. Go back to the vehicle and start the car engine within 30s of the indicator turning solid green. Remove the starter from the battery before driving.
